verdict.rationale: Phaser docs confirm an official CLI tool for scaffolding projects (interactive selection of templates/demo games), which counts as an official CLI, but it is described as interactive Q&A rather than a scriptable/agent-friendly interface, and there's no documentation of flags or non-interactive mode suited for AI-native automated use. missing for 10: evidence of non-interactive/programmatic CLI flags, AI-agent-oriented CLI documentation, and independent confirmation of CLI usability by agents.
